title: Fortinet critical RCE — CVE-2026-44277 (FortiAuthenticator) and CVE-2026-26083 (FortiSandbox) allow unauthenticated code execution

CVE-2026-26083.evidence: FortiSandbox, FortiSandbox Cloud, and FortiSandbox PaaS enabling unauthenticated RCE via HTTP requests. Neither flaw is currently tagged as exploited in the wild, but Fortinet vulnerabilities have been exploited as zero-days 24 times per CISA's KEV catalog, with 13 also abused...
